import urllib.request,urllib.error,json,hashlib,datetime
base="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/"
out={"utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
try:
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+"latest.json",headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-OTA-LiveCheck/1.0","Cache-Control":"no-cache"})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as res:
  raw=res.read(20000);out["manifest_http"]=res.status;out["manifest_content_type"]=res.headers.get("Content-Type","")
 envelope=json.loads(raw);meta=json.loads(envelope["payload"]);out["revision"]=meta["revision"];out["native_min"]=meta["min_native"];out["native_max"]=meta["max_native"]
 name=meta["file"]
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+name,headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-OTA-LiveCheck/1.0"}),timeout=8) as res:
  content=res.read(524289);out["asset_http"]=res.status
 out["file_hash_matches"]=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==meta["sha256"];out["size_matches"]=len(content)==meta["size"]
except Exception as exc:
 out["error_type"]=type(exc).__name__;out["http_code"]=getattr(exc,"code",None)
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
